title: Yellow Yuzu Vietnamese Asparagus Che Ba Mau
description: A spicy and chewy Vietnamese dish featuring asparagus and yuzu cure, served in a raclette grill, this che ba mau is a show-off dish that is gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, fish sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, grated ginger, salt, and black pepper to make the yuzu cure.
Add the sliced Thai chili peppers to the yuzu cure and stir to combine.
Add the asparagus to the yuzu cure and toss to coat.
Brush the raclette grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Add the asparagus to the raclette grill and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until tender.
Serve the asparagus hot, spooning some of the yuzu cure over the top.
Garnish with sliced Thai chili peppers and serve immediately.
